ei.title: A Request for a Salary Raise
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly enjoyed working at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. Since I joined in 2015, I have been a loyal and essential member of this company, and have developed innovative ways to contribute to the company. Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, increasing the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have voluntarily trained 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in raising my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to speaking with you soon. Kimberly Morss

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Krull, I have greatly enjoyed ①<u>to work</u> at Trincom Enterprises as a sales manager. Since I joined in 2015, I have been a loyal and essential member of this company, and have ②<u>developed</u> innovative ways to contribute to the company. Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, increasing the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have voluntarily ③<u>trained</u> 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in raising my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to ④<u>speaking</u> with you soon. Kimberly Morss
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① to work → working: enjoy 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis:
✅ ① to work → working: 'I have greatly enjoyed to work' — 동사 enjoy는 목적어로 동명사를 취하므로 working이 맞음. to work(to부정사)는 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② developed: 'have developed' — 현재완료 과거분사, 정상

❌ ③ trained: 'have voluntarily trained' — 현재완료 과거분사, 정상

❌ ④ speaking: 'look forward to speaking' — to + 동명사, 정상
det.tip: enjoy + 동명사(-ing). enjoy working(○) enjoy to work(✗)

Moreover, in the last year alone, I have brought in two new major clients to the company, increasing the company's total sales by 5%. Also, I have ②<u>voluntary</u> trained 5 new members of staff, totaling 35 hours. I would therefore request your consideration in ③<u>raising</u> my salary, which I believe reflects my performance as well as the industry average. I look forward to ④<u>speaking</u> with you soon. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② voluntary → voluntarily: 동사 trained를 수식하므로 부사
det.analysis:
❌ ① enjoyed: 'have enjoyed' — 현재완료, 정상

✅ ② voluntary → voluntarily: 'I have voluntary trained' — 동사 trained를 수식하므로 부사 voluntarily가 맞음. voluntary(형용사)는 오류 ← 정답

❌ ③ raising: 'in raising my salary' — 전치사 in + 동명사, 정상

❌ ④ speaking: 'look forward to speaking' — to + 동명사, 정상
det.tip: 동사 수식 = 부사(voluntarily). 형용사(voluntary)는 명사 수식

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ reflect → reflects: 관계대명사 which(선행사=급여 인상, 단수)에 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① enjoyed: 'have enjoyed' — 현재완료, 정상

❌ ② developed: 'have developed' — 현재완료, 정상

✅ ③ reflect → reflects: 'my salary, which I believe reflect my performance' — 관계대명사 which가 가리키는 선행사(급여 인상)가 단수이므로 reflects가 맞음. reflect는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답

❌ ④ speaking: 'look forward to speaking' — to + 동명사, 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사절 동사는 선행사의 수에 일치. 단수 선행사 → reflects

det.korean: ① hated → enjoyed: 일하는 것을 즐겨 왔다(enjoyed)는 긍정 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① hated → enjoyed: 'I have greatly hated working at Trincom Enterprises' — 원문은 enjoyed. 헌신과 만족을 강조하는 문맥이므로 hated(싫어했다)는 정반대 ← 정답

❌ ② loyal: 충성스러운 구성원, 문맥 적절

❌ ③ innovative: 혁신적인 방법, 문맥 적절

❌ ④ trained: 신입 직원을 교육했다, 문맥 적절

det.korean: ② decreasing → increasing: 총 매출을 증가시켰다(increasing)는 성과 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① essential: 필수적인 구성원, 문맥 적절

✅ ② decreasing → increasing: 'decreasing the company's total sales by 5%' — 원문은 increasing. 주요 고객사 유치로 매출을 올렸다는 성과이므로 decreasing(감소시키는)은 정반대 ← 정답

❌ ③ trained: 신입 직원을 교육했다, 문맥 적절

❌ ④ raising: 급여를 인상하는 것, 문맥 적절
det.tip: increase(증가시키다) ↔ decrease(감소시키다)

det.analysis:
